title: 第13章 放飞的梦想第14章 关于三女奴

第十三章 放飞的梦想
查红莹第一次一觉睡到了自然醒，虽然都没有吃晚饭，但是她感觉这个晚上是这些年来睡的最安稳的一次。以至于她醒来的时候，还有些茫然失措，然后惊慌的爬起来
完蛋了，没有给大夫人打水洗脸，今天又要糟糕了！！
哎呀！！
查红莹刚刚出门就撞在了一个人的身上，她一抬头，大夫人！！！大夫人竟然亲自跑到了她的破楼，天啊，她该是多生气了？？
慌慌张张的就想跪下去磕头认错，查红莹这些年来已经习惯了挨打挨骂，唯一担心的只是儿子。她不想因为自己的错误，让儿子也承受莫须有的罪责。
但是，大夫人却用比她更快的速度跪了下去，甚至在查红莹还没有反应过来之前，就重重的磕起头来，“红莹，我求求你，救救我的两个宝贝女儿吧，求你了，红莹，现在只有你能救她们了。之前一切都是我的错，我对不起你们母子，我该死，衾儿和笉儿都是我娇惯出来的，她们是无辜的，求你了，红莹，帮帮我，救救她们吧。”
“！！！”查红莹完全傻眼了，这到底是个什么情况？？
更让她傻眼的却还在后头，在旁边等候着的一群人，都是平时跟她一起侍候大夫人二夫人的丫鬟们，此刻一窝蜂的冲了过来，她们的手中大多都捧着一些东西，平时都是大夫人和二夫人才能用的珠宝首饰，绫罗绸缎，胭脂粉饼……顿时不由分说的就把查红莹重新架回了房间，开始在她身上忙碌起来，查红莹甚至想说话都做不到。
等到丫鬟们忙完，查红莹看着面前她们搬来的镜子，几乎不敢相信，那里面的人是自己，那一副贵族夫人的打扮，是她做梦都不敢想象的。
“这……你们……到底是怎么回事？有没有人能告诉我？？”
“查夫人，老爷在大厅那边等你，你去了就明白了。”丫鬟们嘻嘻笑着，或许是因为跟她太熟悉的原因，她们竟然还有心情来打趣她。
大厅中，秦岚老神在在的坐在旁边发呆，一副事不关己的态度，对任何事情都视若不见。黄卡夏侯渊站在他的身后，警惕的看着所有人，他得到了命令，严禁任何人来打搅秦岚的思考。
说的是思考，其实秦岚早已经进入游戏中了。
从穿越开始，这个变异的热血三国游戏以及融入了他身体的电脑，就给了他一个不确定的未来。奋斗了三十年的秦岚，不说看破了人生红尘，却也有自己的人生感悟。人到中年，总是感觉时间太快，他厌倦了孜孜不倦的学习，厌倦了朝九晚五的工作，厌倦了虚伪奉承的应酬。到最后，他想做的，只是自己。他想追求的，只有自己的梦想。
秦岚从小就喜欢三国，喜欢关羽的一骑走天下，喜欢吕布貂蝉的凤仪亭，喜欢诸葛亮的七擒七纵，喜欢周瑜的谈笑湮灭……他时常有幻想，假如自己生在那个时空那个国度会怎么样，是随波逐流，选择一个君主帮他夺天下，又或者自己招募手下，与枭雄曹操刘备争江山？？？
很明显，后者并不容易做到，他一无所有，很难让三国的名将效忠于他，而没有那些谋臣虎将，想与蜀魏吴三国争风，大概下场只是与山越的黄乱，南蛮的孟获，鲜卑的柯比能等人一般，或许更惨……当然最重要的原因，他根本回不去三国世界。
所以他一次次的徘徊在三国的游戏世界，一次次的从零到有的建造自己的国度，招谋臣，抓猛将，一次次沉浸在这种快感之中。
这一次，上天给了他机会，不但让他有了自己独特的三国游戏世界，还穿越到了一个战乱的世界中，他可以在三国游戏中寻找招募自己心仪的名将，然后召唤他们来到现实的这个世界里，帮助他打下一片天地，完成一个另类的争霸游戏！！
这种前所未有的挑战，让秦岚斗志昂扬，与之相比，家里的这点破事，根本都没有放在他的心上。此刻的他，正在城主府中，看着黄卡田丰在处理政事……这并不是他无聊没有事做，其实秦岚是在跟随田丰学习内政。

作为超经典的三国游戏，三国志中武将的学习修炼系统是非常完善的，它幸运的被融入了这个变异的热血三国之中。只要是三国中的武将，在友好度超过80的时候，就可以跟对方学习修炼，为了达到这个目标，需要两个武将进行很多次的互动，而且在志趣和抱负上不要产生冲突才可以提升友好度。但是，在热血三国之中，友好度却是不存在的，它变成了另外一个属性，忠诚度。
而卡片将，开出的所有武将，忠诚都是百分之一百。
所以，秦岚可以直接跟随田丰开始学习，不过虽然田丰的内政和智谋都算不错，但是，已经一百二十级顶级的秦岚，智谋属性也加到了69点，距离田丰的88点，差距虽然有，但是也不是太多，跟随他学习的效果远没有内政那般明显。秦岚的内政此刻只有可怜的十点……而田丰因为已经升到了六级，此刻有八十九点的内政属性，差距是七十九点！！
让秦岚感觉崩溃的是，他在跟田丰谈话并且要求跟他修炼内政之后，黄卡田丰倒是很爽快的答应，但是从哪个时候开始，他的身体就不受控制了，一行一动都是跟随着田丰，田丰在做什么，他就会做什么。而且，这个过程据说要一直持续三个小时……
所以，查红莹兢兢战战的走进大厅的时候，看到的是，秦老爷，那个霸占了她的男人，此刻正颓然的坐在主位上，双眼无神，或者说是茫然，只是脸上的表情却是丰富多彩，时而懊悔，时而恼怒，时而又有一些……悲哀。而她的宝贝儿子，此刻也坐在旁边发呆，身后站着一个一脸肃穆的汉子，警惕的看着所有人，身上散发的威严，就跟她身后寸步不离的那个奇怪的人一样。
他们都是岚儿的属下？？这到底是怎么回事？

Chapter 13: Flying Dreams
For the first time, Zha Hongying slept until she woke up naturally. Although she didn't have dinner, she felt that this night was the most peaceful sleep she had had in years. So much so that when she woke up, she was still a little confused, and then she got up in panic.
Damn it, I didn’t give Madam some water to wash her face, today is going to be bad again! !
oops! !
As soon as Zha Hongying went out, she bumped into someone. When she looked up, Madam! ! ! The eldest lady actually ran to her broken building in person. Oh my god, how angry must she be? ?
She was so panicked that she wanted to kneel down and kowtow to admit her mistake. Zha Hongying had become accustomed to being beaten and scolded over the years. The only thing she worried about was her son. She didn't want her son to bear unwarranted guilt because of her own mistakes.
However, the eldest lady knelt down faster than her. Even before Zha Hongying could react, she kowtowed heavily and said, "Hongying, I beg you, please save my two precious daughters. Please, Hongying, Only you can save them now. Everything was my fault before. I'm sorry for you mother and son. I deserve to die. I spoiled Jian'er and Jie'er. They are innocent. Please, Hongying, help me, save them."
"!!!" Zha Hongying was completely dumbfounded. What on earth is going on? ?
What made her even more dumbfounded was what was still behind her. The group of people waiting nearby were all the maids who usually served the first lady and the second lady with her. At this moment, they rushed over in a swarm. Most of them were holding something in their hands. Usually, they were holding something in their hands. They were all jewelry that could only be used by the eldest lady and the second lady, including silk and satin, rouge powder... Immediately, without any explanation, she took Zha Hongying back to the room and started to work on her. Zha Hongying couldn't even speak.
After the maids finished their work, Zha Hongying looked at the mirror they moved in front of her. She could hardly believe that the person in it was herself. She was dressed like a noble lady, which she could not even imagine in her dreams.
"This...you...what is going on? Can anyone tell me??"
"Mrs. Cha, the master is waiting for you over there in the hall. You will understand when you go there." The maids giggled. Perhaps because they were so familiar with her, they were still in the mood to tease her.
In the hall, the old god Qin Lan was sitting beside him in a daze, with an attitude that it had nothing to do with him and turned a blind eye to everything. Huang Kaxia Houyuan stood behind him, looking at everyone vigilantly. He was ordered to strictly prohibit anyone from disturbing Qin Lan's thinking.
I'm talking about thinking. In fact, Qin Lan has already entered the game.
From the beginning of time travel, this mutated Three Kingdoms game and the computer integrated into his body gave him an uncertain future. Qin Lan, who has struggled for thirty years, has not only seen through the world of life, but also has her own insights into life. When a person reaches middle age, he always feels that time flies too fast. He is tired of tireless study, tired of nine-to-five work, and tired of hypocritical and flattering entertainment. In the end, all he wants to do is himself. All he wants to pursue is his dream.
Qin Lan has been fond of the Three Kingdoms since he was a child, he likes Guan Yu's Riding the World, Lu Bu Diaochan's Fengyiting, Zhuge Liang's Seven Captures and Seven Cops, Zhou Yu's Talking, Laughing and Annihilation... He often has fantasies, what if he was born in that country in that time and space, would he go with the flow and choose a monarch to help him conquer the world, or recruit his own men to compete with the hero Cao Cao and Liu Bei? ? ?
Obviously, the latter is not easy to achieve. He has nothing, and it is difficult to get the famous generals of the Three Kingdoms to be loyal to him. Without those advisers and tiger generals, if he wants to compete with the three kingdoms of Shu, Wei and Wu, he will probably end up with the Huang Chaos of Shanyue, Meng Huo of the Nanman, Kirby of Xianbei and others, maybe even worse... Of course, the most important reason is that he cannot go back to the world of the Three Kingdoms at all.
So he wandered again and againWandering in the game world of the Three Kingdoms, building your own kingdom from scratch again and again, recruiting advisers, catching strong generals, and immersing yourself in this pleasure again and again.
This time, God gave him the opportunity. Not only did he have his own unique Three Kingdoms game world, but he also traveled to a war-torn world. He could find and recruit his favorite generals in the Three Kingdoms game, and then summon them to the real world to help him conquer a world and complete an alternative hegemony game! !
This unprecedented challenge made Qin Lan high-spirited. Compared with this, the troubles at home did not concern him at all. At this moment, he was in the city lord's palace, watching Huang Katian Feng deal with political affairs... It wasn't that he was bored and had nothing to do. In fact, Qin Lan was studying internal affairs with Tian Feng.
As a super classic Three Kingdoms game, the learning and training system of generals in the Three Kingdoms is very complete, and it is fortunate to be integrated into this mutated and bloody Three Kingdoms. As long as they are military generals in the Three Kingdoms, when their friendship level exceeds 80, they can learn and practice with each other. In order to achieve this goal, the two generals need to interact many times, and they must not conflict in their interests and ambitions to improve their friendship. However, in the Three Kingdoms, friendship does not exist. It becomes another attribute, loyalty.
As for card generals, all generals drawn are 100% loyal.
Therefore, Qin Lan can directly start learning from Tian Feng. However, although Tian Feng's internal affairs and resourcefulness are both good, Qin Lan, who is already at the top level 120, has also increased his resourcefulness attribute to 69 points, which is 88 points away from Tian Feng. Although there is a gap, it is not too much. The effect of studying with him is far less obvious than that of internal affairs. Qin Lan's internal affairs attribute is only a pitiful ten points at the moment... and Tian Feng, because he has been promoted to level six, has eighty-nine points of internal affairs attribute at the moment, the difference is seventy-nine points! !
What made Qin Lan feel crushed was that after he talked to Tian Feng and asked to practice internal affairs with him, Huang Ka Tian Feng readily agreed. However, from that moment on, his body was out of control and he followed Tian Feng in every move. Whatever Tian Feng was doing, he would do. Moreover, this process is said to last for three hours...
Therefore, when Zha Hongying walked into the hall cautiously, what she saw was that Mr. Qin, the man who occupied her, was sitting slumped on the main seat, his eyes were dull, or blank, but the expressions on his face were colorful, sometimes regretful, sometimes angry, sometimes a little...sad. And her precious son was sitting beside her in a daze at the moment. Behind her stood a man with a solemn face, looking at everyone warily. The majesty exuding from his body was the same as that of the strange man who stayed behind her.
Are they all Lan'er's subordinates? ? What the hell is going on?
